name: read_file
description:
- Reads and returns the content of a specified file
- Supports line-based slicing for reading specific portions of large files
- Each content line is prefixed with its 1-based line number for reference
- When using 'edit_file', provide the exact text WITHOUT the line-number prefix
- Use this tool when you need to read the contents of a file to understand its logic or data

path.description: The path to the file to read.

offset.description: Optional: The 1-based line number to start reading from. Defaults to the beginning of the file.

limit.description: Optional: The maximum number of lines to read. Defaults to all remaining lines.
